prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the silicone container from workbench to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether two silicone containers are on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Centre frame: a white translucent plastic squeeze/wash bottle standing upright on a white platform, fitted with a red angled cap/spout that is closed, and a blue band around the bottle's midsection. The bottle appears to hold a clear or colourless liquid; contents are not clearly visible through the opaque plastic. Behind the bottle is a white robotic arm segment with a black cable looping over the bottle's cap area, and a small white label or tag at the bottle's right side. The platform sits on an aluminium extrusion rail/linear track running diagonally from lower left to upper right, with metal bolts and a round white disc mounted in front of the bottle. A second empty white mounting disc lies at lower centre. Right side: dark grey panelled surface. Upper left: pale grey benchtop with white trays and an instrument.
observations: The image shows only one container-like object (a white squeeze/wash bottle) on the platform, plus an empty mounting disc; no second silicone container is visible on the workbench.
